decisions.reason: A newly launched lever handle family fits the firm's core coordinated-range strategy, and one year is too soon to judge it against aspirations, so the firm's established slack lets it carry the line.
The mitred lever family extends the design-led portfolio at low incremental cost, and with no evidence of a shortfall there is no trigger for problemistic search.
A multifunctional handle supports the barrier-free and system-solution direction, so management will give it time to reach aspiration levels rather than drop it early.
A standard lever handle line shares tooling and finishing with existing ranges, so carrying it is cheap while its results are still uncertain.
The collection won the German Design Award and has its own page, so it exceeds aspirations and is clearly retained.
A bronze finish option uses in-house finishing capabilities across the handle families, so it adds value at minimal cost and gives no reason to withdraw it.
